title: Invoice Governance Trigger Limited to UPDATE Leaving INSERT Unprotected
description: Trigger trg_invoice_sequence_governance in c7_13 was created BEFORE UPDATE only. An adversary or migration executing a direct INSERT with approval_status = APPROVED could bypass all synthetic approver checks.
remediation: Forward-only migration c7_14 upgrades trigger to BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE, enforcing that series cannot be inserted directly in APPROVED status and must follow the statutory lifecycle.
verification: TEST-P44-DB-03 and TEST-P44-DB-04 verify direct INSERT in APPROVED status is strictly rejected with exception 23514.

title: Audit Immutability Row-Level Trigger Fails to Intercept TRUNCATE
description: PostgreSQL row-level triggers (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE FOR EACH ROW) do not execute during TRUNCATE. An identity with TRUNCATE privileges could erase all statutory approval audit history in a single command.
remediation: Forward-only migration c7_14 adds statement-level trigger trg_invoice_series_audit_truncate (BEFORE TRUNCATE FOR EACH STATEMENT) raising exception 23514.
verification: TEST-P44-DB-12 verifies direct TRUNCATE is blocked with STATUTORY_SECURITY_VIOLATION.

title: Triggers Vulnerable to Suppression Under session_replication_role = replica
description: Standard PostgreSQL triggers do not fire if a session with replication privileges sets session_replication_role to replica.
remediation: Forward-only migration c7_14 marks triggers ENABLE ALWAYS on both public.invoice_sequence and public.invoice_series_approval_audit.
verification: TEST-P44-DB-13 and TEST-P44-DB-14 verify triggers fire and block violations even when session_replication_role = replica.

title: Migration Linter Evasion via Multiline Splitting, Comments, and Dynamic SQL
description: Phase 4.3 lint_migrations.cjs used line-by-line regex matching, allowing bypasses via inline block comments (/* bypass */), multiline assignments, and dynamic SQL (EXECUTE).
remediation: Hardened lint_migrations.cjs with zero-dependency lexical comment stripping, whitespace normalization, and dynamic SQL detection.
verification: Adversarial corpus ADV-LINT-01 through ADV-LINT-15 achieved 15/15 (100%) detection pass rate.

title: Statutory Approval Endpoint Accepted Anonymous or Empty userId Payloads
description: route.ts line 10478 checked role but did not explicitly reject userId === "anonymous", allowing unauthenticated tokens with forged role claims to approve series.
remediation: Hardened route.ts to reject !userCtx.userId || userCtx.userId === "anonymous" with HTTP 403.
verification: TEST-P44-API-04 verifies anonymous token payload is rejected with HTTP 403.

title: Production Statutory Invoice Series Designation Pending Board Resolution
description: CakeToHome India Private Limited Board of Directors has not yet adopted a formal resolution designating the official production invoice prefix and delegating statutory approval authority.
remediation: Invoicing remains intentionally fail-closed. No production prefix is approved until corporate resolution is executed.
verification: Confirmed zero APPROVED series in production baseline; invoicing strictly fail-closed.
